title: What to Ask a Turkish Clinic Before Paying Any Deposit
seoTitle: What to Ask a Turkish Clinic Before Paying Any Deposit
metaDescription: Ask these 12 clinical, staffing, refund, and data-privacy questions to any Turkish clinic before wiring a deposit or sharing sensitive medical files.
quickAnswer: Before paying any deposit to a Turkish clinic, ask 12 direct questions covering Ministry of Health authorization, the exact doctor performing each surgical step, daily patient volume, anesthesia credentials, emergency hospital backup, itemized billing, written revision and refund policies, and secure channels for personal health data.
category: Medical Travel to Türkiye — Independent Advisory & Safety (The ITO Standard)

body.text: Which 12 clinical and logistical questions separate vetted clinics from mills?

Vetted Turkish hospitals and specialist clinics welcome written due-diligence questions, whereas high-volume clinic mills answer with vague assurances or sales pressure. Asking 12 concrete questions in writing—before wiring a deposit—forces clarity on licensing, physician accountability, hospital backup, aftercare, and refund terms so you can compare providers objectively.
Use this 12-question pre-deposit checklist with every clinic you shortlist:

items: What is your legal entity name and [Republic of Türkiye Ministry of Health](https://shgmturizmdb.saglik.gov.tr/EN-69289/healthcare-providers-with-international-health-tourism-authorization-certificates.html) International Health Tourism Authorization Certificate number?
What is the full name and specialist registration of the doctor who will treat me?
Which exact steps does the doctor perform personally, and how many patients are booked that day?
Will I have a direct video or in-person consultation with the treating doctor before paying?
Who administers anesthesia, and will the procedure take place in a licensed full-service hospital?
Which accredited hospital provides 24/7 emergency and ICU backup if a complication occurs?
What is included—and excluded—in the itemized quote (hospital nights, labs, garments, medications)?
Will I receive an official, tax-compliant hospital invoice and English informed consent form before surgery?
What is your exact written policy on complications, revisions, and deposit refunds?
How many post-op check-ups are scheduled in Türkiye, and who issues my fit-to-fly letter?
Will I receive complete English discharge notes, implant serial numbers, and operative reports?
Which encrypted, official channel should I use if I later decide to share medical records?

body.text: Who performs each step of the procedure and how many patients are booked per day?

Always confirm in writing which steps your licensed physician performs hands-on versus which support tasks nurses or assistants handle. In fields like hair restoration, the [ISHRS Fight the FIGHT campaign](https://fightthefight.ishrs.org/before-you-choose-a-surgeon/) warns that unlicensed technicians illegally perform incisions and extractions at high-volume clinics while a doctor's name sits only on the brochure.

Similarly, [NHS cosmetic surgery abroad guidance](https://www.nhs.uk/tests-and-treatments/cosmetic-procedures/advice/cosmetic-surgery-abroad/) advises having two consultations with the operating surgeon and never paying to see a surgeon you have not met. Ask directly how many surgeries the doctor oversees per day; a single specialist performing one or two focused cases operates very differently from a clinic rotating ten patients through parallel rooms.

body.text: What is the exact revision, complication and refund policy in writing?

Never rely on verbal assurances that a clinic will "take care of you" if plans change or complications arise. Request a written contract stating deposit refund deadlines, medical-cancellation terms if pre-op labs disqualify you, and who pays for hospital readmission, extra nights, or revision surgery.

Because standard holiday policies exclude elective surgery, review our guide on [medical travel insurance for Türkiye](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blog/medical-travel-insurance-turkey) and compare the clinic's terms against [medical tourism red flags in Türkiye](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blog/medical-tourism-red-flags-turkey). Remember that even generous clinic revision policies rarely cover return international flights or companion hotels.
Why should you never send ID or medical files before verifying the channel?

Under Türkiye's [Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK)](https://www.kvkk.gov.tr/Icerik/6649/Personal-Data-Protection-Law), health records are classified as [special categories of personal data](https://www.kvkk.gov.tr/Icerik/6609/Conditions-for-Processing-Of-Special-Categories-of-Personal-Data) requiring strict confidentiality and explicit consent. Sending passport scans, clinical photos, or lab files over an unverified WhatsApp number exposes you to identity theft and unauthorized sharing with third-party commission brokers.

Verify the hospital's official domain, legal entity, and Ministry of Health listing first, and wait until you have confirmed an official intake portal or verified corporate email before transmitting sensitive documents. faq.q: Is it normal for Turkish clinics to ask for a deposit before I fly?
faq.a: Yes, reputable hospitals often request a modest deposit to reserve an operating room, but only after you receive a written itemized quote, clear refund terms, and direct confirmation of the treating doctor.

faq.q: Should I pay a deposit before speaking with the actual doctor?
faq.a: No. Follow [NHS guidance](https://www.nhs.uk/tests-and-treatments/cosmetic-procedures/advice/cosmetic-surgery-abroad/) and insist on speaking directly with the treating physician—not just a sales coordinator—before committing money.

faq.q: What happens if my pre-op blood tests in Türkiye show I cannot have surgery?
faq.a: Ask in writing before paying. A transparent clinic states clearly whether your deposit is refunded minus lab costs or held as credit if your doctor cancels surgery for safety reasons.

faq.q: Why do I need English operative notes and implant serial numbers?
faq.a: If you ever need follow-up care from your home doctor or dentist, complete English discharge summaries and device serial numbers are essential for safe continuity of care.

faq.q: How do I know if a WhatsApp number belongs to the actual hospital or a broker?
faq.a: Cross-check the phone number and email domain on the hospital's official website and verify whether the contact is a direct hospital employee or a commission intermediary.

faq.q: Can Itinerary of Türkiye negotiate medical protocols with my surgeon?
